characters.name: PEETER
characters.description: Väike inimene, rõõmsameelne poiss. Tal on lühikesed pruunid juuksed ja suured sinised silmad. Kannab siniseid pükse ja kollast T-särki. Sõbralik ja energiline. Armas multifilmistiil.

characters.name: LIISA
characters.description: Väike inimene, rõõmsameelne tüdruk. Tal on pikad blondid juuksed, mis on patsis, ja säravad rohelised silmad. Kannab roosat kleiti ja valgeid sandaale. Naeratav ja uudishimulik. Armas multifilmistiil.

locations.name: LASTETUBA
locations.description: Cozy children's bedroom with yellow walls, wooden floor. A single window on the back wall showing bright green spring trees outside. A small wooden toy chest on the right wall. A colorful kite (red, blue, yellow) is leaning against the left wall. Warm sunlight fills the room. Cartoon style.

locations.name: ROHELINE VÄLI
locations.description: Wide open green grassy field with a gentle rolling hill in the background. Bright blue sky with a few fluffy white clouds. A few small, distant spring trees on the horizon. A light breeze is visible. Sunny day. Cartoon style.

pages.scene: Peeter and Liisa stand inside a cozy children's bedroom. Peeter points excitedly at a colorful red, blue, and yellow kite leaning against the left wall. Liisa looks at the kite with a curious smile. The room has yellow walls, a wooden floor, a single window showing bright green spring trees, and a small wooden toy chest. Warm sunlight fills the room. Cartoon style. Peeter is wearing blue pants and a yellow T-shirt. Liisa is wearing a pink dress and white sandals.

Peeter and Liisa are still in the cozy children's bedroom. Peeter holds the colorful red, blue, and yellow kite and looks at Liisa, who is clapping her hands with a hopeful expression. They both look eager to go outside. The room has yellow walls, a wooden floor, a single window showing bright green spring trees, and a small wooden toy chest. Warm sunlight fills the room. Cartoon style. Peeter is wearing blue pants and a yellow T-shirt. Liisa is wearing a pink dress and white sandals.

Peeter and Liisa are now outside in a wide open green grassy field. Peeter holds the colorful red, blue, and yellow kite. Liisa walks beside him, looking around happily. Cartoon style. Peeter is wearing blue pants and a yellow T-shirt. Liisa is wearing a pink dress and white sandals.
